title: In this town, every footprint glows until sunrise
description:
In this town, every footprint you leave glows until the next sunrise, each of us in our own colour. By morning everyone's trail is gone. At Nan's orchard, mine never fade.

I came back for the harvest week. Every dawn there was a new trail in the rows, huge square prints that didn't glow at all, and each morning they stopped a little nearer the house.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: Where would last night's footprints say you went?
